page.overview:
Who is Boss?

Boss is a male Carnotaurus who appeared in , , and as a minor antagonist.

He can easily be recognized by his distinct broken horn and three big scars across the left side of his face. He also has a different color scheme than other Carnotaurus individuals instead of having a brownish red color he has a reddish charcoal color across his body and red on his face with more pointy spikes down his back than others making it easy to mistake him for Toro the other male Carnotaurus.

In , Boss is depicted with Toro's model before it was burned with its broken horn, however his scars are absent, making it inconsistent with the live-action appearances of the dinosaur.

Not much is known about Boss’ background except he was present on Isla Nublar during the time before and after the Jurassic World Incident until the eruption of the island’s volcano Mount Sibo.
